channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, Asia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, Asia, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Grant: i Light Singapore 2027 Open Call: light art installations for Marina Bay (budget up to SGD 18,000 per artwork, theme: Resonance) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
i Light Singapore (Urban Redevelopment Authority, managed by Pico Art International)
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 Singapore time
Award: Artwork budget capped at SGD 18,000 per selected installation, covering artist and design fee, production, certification, manpower and (for overseas artists) withholding tax. On top of that the festival covers return sea freight, insurance, venue and approvals, general maintenance and security, and airfare plus accommodation for one person for up to 5 days. No application fee mentioned.

i Light Singapore, the light festival run by Singapore's Urban Redevelopment Authority since 2010, is commissioning light art installations for its 13th edition around Marina Bay.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: TBG+S / TOKAS International Residency Exchange 2027: three months in Tokyo for an Irish or Ireland-based visual artist (closes 27 Nov)
item.description:
Temple Bar Gallery + Studios (Dublin) with Tokyo Arts and Space (TOKAS)
Deadline: 27 Nov 2026, 17:00 GMT
Award: A stipend covering living and working expenses, travel to and from Tokyo, and on-site single-room accommodation. The stipend amount is not given on the call page. No application fee stated.

Temple Bar Gallery + Studios in Dublin sends one visual artist to Tokyo Arts and Space for a three-month residency in autumn 2027, as part of its exchange with TOKAS. WHO: professional practising visual artists who either live in Ireland or are Irish and live anywhere in the world.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: n-Space Fellowship, Singapore Fellow (Prediction): 9-month art and technology fellowship with 3 months at Somerset House Studios, London (GBP 5,000 fee, travel and accommodation covered) (closes 7 Dec)
item.description:
Somerset House Studios with the National Arts Council Singapore; research partner UAL Creative Computing Institute; supported by the Rothschild Foundation
Deadline: 7 Dec 2026, 10:00 GMT
Award: GBP 5,000 fellowship fee, plus return flights to London, accommodation, per diems and ground transport for both London visits, and access to a GBP 30,000 R&D fund shared by the six-person cohort. No application fee mentioned.

The Singapore place in the second n-Space fellowship cohort at Somerset House Studios, run with the National Arts Council Singapore.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: Sado Island Galaxy Art Festival 2027: Open Call (Japan; production grant up to about JPY 2,000,000) (closes 22 Dec)
item.description:
Sado International Art Promotion Organization
Deadline: 22 Dec 2026, 17:00 Tokyo time
Award: Production grant of up to about JPY 2,000,000 per project, with artist fees itemised in the budget. JPY 1,500 application fee per proposal.

About 4 to 5 site-specific projects are selected for an 85-day island art festival on Sado. There are six categories, including one for advanced technology integration, and proposals should engage the island's history, ecology, climate and marine issues.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: IDFA Bertha Fund: IBF Classic 2027 (documentary development up to EUR 7,500, production up to EUR 25,000) (closes 10 Feb 2027)
item.description:
IDFA Bertha Fund (IDFA, Amsterdam)
Deadline: 10 Feb 2027
Award: Project Development up to EUR 7,500; Production and Post-production up to EUR 25,000. No application fee mentioned.

The IDFA Bertha Fund's IBF Classic scheme supports creative documentaries by filmmakers from countries on its Global South and Eastern Europe country list.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Grant: Awesome Foundation Local Chapters: USD 1,000 Monthly Micro-grants (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NL, Asia) (rolling)
item.description:
Awesome Foundation (local chapters)
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Usually USD 1,000 (or local equivalent) per grant, no strings attached, typically one grant per chapter per month. No application fee.

The Awesome Foundation is a network of volunteer giving circles: in each chapter about ten trustees pool their own money to give a USD 1,000 no-strings micro-grant, usually monthly, to a project that adds "awesome" to their area: art, public interventions, community tech, events, science and civic...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: Ubah Rumah Residency 2027/2028 (Nikoi Island, Indonesia; Southeast Asian artists) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Ubah Rumah
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: Artist fee (figure not published), accommodation and a round trip within Southeast Asia.

A residency on Nikoi Island focused on art, ecology and hospitality. ELIGIBILITY: artists from or based in Southeast Asia. OFFER: an artist fee (amount not published), accommodation and a round trip within Southeast Asia, for a stay of four to six weeks in 2027 or 2028.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Residency: Frankfurt Moves! Frankfurt LAB Residency Stipend 2027 (closes 7 Dec)
item.description:
Frankfurt LAB and KfW Stiftung
Deadline: 7 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 2,750 gross stipend per person (EUR 2,000 for the Frankfurt month, EUR 750 for the remote month), plus four weeks of accommodation, round-trip travel to Frankfurt and up to EUR 800 for artistic work expenses per person or team. No application fee.

Frankfurt Moves!, an initiative of KfW Stiftung run with the Frankfurt LAB (the production space shared by Ensemble Modern, Dresden Frankfurt Dance Company, Hessische Theaterakademie, HfMDK Frankfurt and Mousonturm), offers four two-step residencies for emerging performing artists, solo or in teams...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme 2027/28 (HKD 344,400 a year for up to three years; 400 fellowships, practice-led art PhDs included) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Research Grants Council (RGC) of Hong Kong, with eight Hong Kong universities
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 Hong Kong time
Award: Annual stipend of HKD 344,400 (about USD 44,150) plus a conference and research travel allowance of HKD 14,400 a year, for up to three years (2026/27 rates as published by the RGC). Some universities add top-ups: HKBU lists a HKD 40,000-a-year Elite Scholar Award for three years, a further HKD 20,000 travel top-up, four years of tuition waiver and two years of guaranteed accommodation. 400 fellowships for 2027/28.

The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme, run by the Research Grants Council, funds around 400 new full-time PhD students a year at eight Hong Kong universities, in any discipline, including AI, computing and data science programmes and practice-led art research (Hong Kong Baptist University's Academy...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Mophradat New Agents 2027: collective curatorial program (USD 6,000 stipend, Arab world) (closes 6 Dec)
item.description:
Mophradat
Deadline: 6 Dec 2026
Award: USD 6,000 stipend per participant, to use at their discretion, paid 2,500 / 2,500 / 1,000. Mophradat also covers retreat travel and a budget for the public event. Number of participants not stated (a small group). No application fee stated.

New Agents brings a small group of art practitioners (artists, curators and researchers) together for ten months to co-develop and realise a public event, such as a conference, festival or exhibition, that foregrounds the collective curatorial experience rather than the participants' individual...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Jumping Frames 2027: Hong Kong International Movement-Image Festival, Open Call (Copy Right Copy Left) (closes 16 Dec)
item.description:
City Contemporary Dance Company (CCDC)
Deadline: 16 Dec 2026
Award: Jumping Frames International Award HKD 15,000 (figure from secondary listings of the 2027 call; confirm on the official site). Entry fees vary by deadline tier.

Open call for dance and movement-image films up to 20 minutes for the 2027 Jumping Frames festival. The 2027 theme, Copy Right Copy Left, explicitly invites AI and digital tools and asks about authorship in the AI era.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: HKADC Cultural Exchange Project Grant (up to HKD 500,000 for Hong Kong artists working abroad) (closes 31 Dec)
item.description:
Hong Kong Arts Development Council (HKADC)
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026, 18:00 Hong Kong time
Award: General Version: up to HKD 500,000 for individual artists and arts organisations, covering all project expenditure except listed exclusions; up to HKD 800,000 for experienced organisations with large-scale, outstanding exchange projects. Trial Version: up to HKD 150,000 for transportation, freight, insurance and documentation only. No application fee stated.

The Hong Kong Arts Development Council's Cultural Exchange Project Grant supports Hong Kong artists and arts organisations taking work abroad: overseas exhibitions, performances, festival participation, residencies, touring and similar exchange activity, across music, dance, xiqu, drama, visual...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: HKADC Emerging Artists Development Grant (up to HKD 90,000, Hong Kong arts graduates) (closes 31 Dec)
item.description:
Hong Kong Arts Development Council (HKADC)
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026, 18:00 Hong Kong time
Award: Grant ceiling HKD 90,000 per project (HKADC may exceed the ceiling for projects of great potential, subject to resources). No application fee stated.

The Hong Kong Arts Development Council's Emerging Artists Development Grant funds a first arts project by recent graduates: performances, exhibitions, publications, creation of artwork, translation and other project types allowed under its general Project Grant.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: 51st Hong Kong International Film Festival 2027: Call for Entries (features, documentaries, Short Film Competition) (closes 31 Dec)
item.description:
Hong Kong International Film Festival Society (HKIFF)
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026
Award: EXCEPTION: NOT FUNDED (festival call). Selection for one of Asia's oldest film festivals and its competitions; prize amounts not stated in the call. Entry fees from 4 November to 31 December 2026: Short Film Competition (under 20 minutes) USD 50 / HKD 390; all other categories USD 80 / HKD 624. Fee waiver for documentaries by directors holding a Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card. Fees non-refundable.

The Hong Kong International Film Festival, one of Asia's oldest film festivals, is taking submissions for its 51st edition (16-29 March 2027).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Asian Cultural Council Individual Fellowship 2027 (up to USD 35,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 35,000 for self-directed exploration and cultural exchange of 1 to 6 months. Single or joint applications (up to 3 participants). No application fee.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council New York Fellowship 2027 (USD 38,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · USD 38,000 for the six-month fellowship, covering the immersive cultural exchange in New York City. No application fee.

item.title: Busan Metropolitan City: Open Call for Land / Ecological Art on Eulsukdo
item.description: Busan Metropolitan City, Urban Parks Division · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · One proposal selected. Artwork support KRW 380,000,000 (approx. EUR 235,000) plus artist fee KRW 20,000,000 (approx. EUR 12,500). No entry fee indicated.
